text: 据工业和信息化部消息，<u>目前国家产融合作平台助企融资规模已突破1.8万亿元</u>，平台入驻企业超过40万家。国家产融合作平台是依托工业和信息化部及相关金融机构数据资源建立的非营利性公共服务平台，可以为企业提供定制化、智能化的金融服务。为了推动企业融资需求和金融产品的精准匹配，平台建立数据对接共享机制，共享多个部门和机构数据，并通过整合重点企业标签，挖掘数据模型算法价值。<u>截至2026年10月，平台入驻企业46万家，其中制造业企业占比60%</u>。
text_en: According to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the national industry-finance cooperation platform has now facilitated more than 1.8 trillion yuan in financing for enterprises, with more than 400,000 enterprises registered on the platform. The national industry-finance cooperation platform is a non-profit public service platform built on data resources from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and relevant financial institutions, providing enterprises with customized and intelligent financial services. To promote precise matching of enterprise financing needs and financial products, the platform has established a data docking and sharing mechanism, sharing data from multiple departments and institutions, and tapping the value of data model algorithms by integrating key enterprise tags. As of October 2026, 460,000 enterprises were registered on the platform, of which manufacturing enterprises accounted for 60%.
